project.name: pictochat-decomp
project.title: PictoChat
project.tagline: byte-matching the DSi's chat app, function by function
project.compiler: mwccarm (CodeWarrior for embedded ARM), a dsi/ build - version NOT yet pinned. Sweep the dsi builds (dsi/1.1, 1.1p1, 1.2, 1.2p1, 1.2p2, 1.3, 1.3p1, 1.6sp1, 1.6sp2); dsi/1.3 is the working guess for a 2009 launch-window system title. Flags (ARM9): -O4,p -enum int -lang c99 -char signed -interworking -thumb -proc arm946e -gccext,on -msgstyle gcc -Iinclude. ARM7: same but -proc arm7tdmi. -thumb is confirmed necessary (mwccarm otherwise emits ARM-mode even for tiny leaf funcs the ROM has as Thumb); override per-function with --flags if a candidate comes out the wrong size.
project.cppNote: If a name starts with _Z (C++ mangled), write C++ with the FIRST LINE exactly //cpp - the build compiles a src file as C++ when its first line is //cpp, else as c99.
project.setup: clone {github} and follow CONTRIBUTING.md. You bring your own dumps (nothing copyrighted is in the repo): your own DSi PictoChat title (assets/pictochat.nds) and your own ARM7 BIOS (assets/bios7.bin). Set up mwccarm (a dsi build) per notes/setup-mwccarm.md, `pip install ndspy capstone pyelftools pyghidra`, then `python tools/extract_pictochat.py` to populate extracted/.
project.readFirst: notes/matching-style.md (matching levers + known walls), notes/tooling.md (the tool suite), and notes/pictochat-layout.md (why the total is Ghidra's estimate, not dsd's). Coordinate your span in CLAIMS.md.
project.submitting: Before opening a PR read CONTRIBUTING.md. Every file you add to src/ MUST byte-reproduce the binary (tools/match.py green) - that is the only merge gate. One matched function per src/arm9/<symbol>.c|.cpp or src/arm7/<symbol>.c|.cpp (first line //cpp for C++). Claim your span in CLAIMS.md first. A logic-correct but NOT byte-exact draft is parked with a `// NONMATCHING:` marker via tools/nonmatching.py - it does not count as matched and must not be presented as a match. Before hand-writing anything, try the free tiers: `python tools/sync_ledger.py --apply` then `python tools/cross_match.py --other-repo ../sm64ds-decomp` (cross-project + template matching has already landed dozens with no hand-writing).
project.rules: only your own legally dumped DSi title and BIOS; never commit the ROM, the BIOS, firmware, or anything extracted/derived from them (see .gitignore) - the repo holds only original work: scripts, hand-written C, notes. Import struct/field knowledge (see CREDITS) but write all C from scratch.
project.nearMissNote: If a function will not fully match after real effort, do not discard your best attempt - keep the closest compiling draft parked as NONMATCHING (tools/nonmatching.py); it is the highest-yield starting point for a later match, and most matches now start from someone's stored draft or a cross-project hit.

matchConventions.srcLayout: src/arm9/<symbol>.c|.cpp and src/arm7/<symbol>.c|.cpp, one matched function each
matchConventions.decompMarker: each src file carries a `// decomp: <module> <addr>` marker (tools/ledger.py MARKER_RE) that ties it to a function address
matchConventions.ledger: tools/ledger.py + tools/sync_ledger.py (marker-based, catches committed src/ up)
matchConventions.nonMatching: tools/nonmatching.py parks logic-correct, not-byte-exact drafts with a `// NONMATCHING:` marker

project.progressNote: Matched function COUNT is computable from committed src/ alone; the TOTAL count and percentage come from Ghidra's function estimate (extracted/, git-ignored, ROM-derived), so a precise percentage needs a local extracted/ - see notes/pictochat-layout.md. dsd's own function search does not finish for this title.

GITHUB_TOKEN.note: Read-only GitHub token. Raises the API rate limit (anonymous is 60/hr) so contributor stats and PR-based match attribution work. A fine-grained token with public-repo read access is enough - stored encrypted on your machine, never shared.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.note: Only if you drive the model-assisted draft tools (tools/m2c_draft.py, tools/ghidra_draft.py, the permuter loop) over the API instead of from an editor session.

tools.label: Progress report
tools.description: How much of the title is matched, in functions and bytes. The total is Ghidra's function estimate rather than dsd's - see notes/pictochat-layout.md.

args.name: bar
args.description: Print just the README progress block.

tools.label: Sync the ledger
tools.description: Catch the matched-function ledger up with what is committed in src/, by reading each file's decomp marker.

args.name: apply
args.description: Write progress/matched.jsonl rather than only reporting.

tools.label: Rebuild atlas data
tools.description: Regenerate chaos-db.json, the progress data the Chaos Viewer reads.

tools.label: Disassemble
tools.description: Disassemble ROM bytes at an address, resolving pc-relative pool loads. Where you start when reading a function you are about to write.

args.name: module
args.description: main, itcm, unk_autoload_0, unk_autoload_2 or arm7.

args.name: toNext
args.description: Run to the next known function's start.

args.name: thumb
args.description: Decode as Thumb rather than ARM.

tools.label: Diff candidate vs ROM
tools.description: Instruction-level diff of a candidate against the ROM. What to reach for when match says no: it shows WHERE it diverges.

args.name: c
args.description: Path to the candidate C/C++ file.

args.name: module
args.description: main, itcm, unk_autoload_0, unk_autoload_2 or arm7.

args.name: align
args.description: Align the streams to separate real differences from drift.

tools.label: Probe compiler versions
tools.description: Compile one candidate across mwccarm builds to see which produce the ROM's bytes. This title's compiler version is NOT pinned yet, so this is how it gets narrowed down.

args.name: c
args.description: Path to the candidate C/C++ file.

tools.label: Match advisor
tools.description: Read a candidate and suggest what to change to close the gap.

args.name: c
args.description: Path to the candidate C/C++ file.

args.name: sweep
args.description: Also report which pinned builds match.

tools.label: Search other decomps
tools.description: Scrape and search other NDS decomps for patterns, including full-text search of their own notes on this toolchain's quirks. Often the fastest answer to a codegen question somebody else already solved.

args.name: sub
args.description: scrape, search, cross-match, info or notes.

tools.label: Verify a match
tools.description: THE merge gate: compile a candidate and compare it byte-for-byte with the ROM. Green here is the only thing that counts as matched.

args.name: c
args.description: Path to the candidate C/C++ file.

args.name: module
args.description: main, itcm, unk_autoload_0, unk_autoload_2 or arm7.

args.name: trio
args.description: Sweep the dsi/ builds - the compiler version is not pinned yet.

args.name: flags
args.description: Override the compiler flags for this function.

tools.label: Cross-project match
tools.description: Find functions already matched in another decomp that byte-match here. Has landed dozens with no hand-writing - try it before anything else.

args.name: otherRepo
args.description: Path to the other decomp, e.g. ../sm64ds-decomp.

args.name: minFuzzy
args.description: Minimum structural similarity to report a non-identical candidate.

tools.label: Template sweep
tools.description: Try known codegen templates against unmatched functions in a size range. A free tier: it costs compiles, not thinking.

args.name: module
args.description: main, itcm, unk_autoload_0, unk_autoload_2 or arm7.

args.name: apply
args.description: Bank the wins rather than only reporting them.

args.name: extend
args.description: Retry past Ghidra's cached size by up to this many bytes, catching a trailing literal pool its boundary excluded.

tools.label: Twin search
tools.description: Find an already-matched function with the same instruction skeleton and reuse its shape. --relax casts wider, since a wrong guess only costs one compile.

args.name: limit
args.description: Cap how many targets to work through.

args.name: relax
args.description: Compare normalised mnemonics and verify every twin.

args.name: tries
args.description: With --relax, most twins to try per target.

tools.label: Find duplicate functions
tools.description: Find unmatched functions byte-identical to ones already matched. Free matches; dry-run unless --apply.

tools.label: Sweep candidate shapes
tools.description: Generate and score many C shapes for one function, reporting the closest.

args.name: top
args.description: How many of the best candidates to report.

tools.label: Frame search
tools.description: Take a seed C file marked up with choice points and search the combinations for a match.

args.name: seed
args.description: Seed C file carrying the choice-point markers.

args.name: module
args.description: main, itcm, unk_autoload_0, unk_autoload_2 or arm7.

args.name: keep
args.description: How many best candidates to save.

tools.label: Declaration-order search
tools.description: Permute the order of local declarations, one of the few levers that actually moves register allocation on this compiler.

args.name: module
args.description: main, itcm, unk_autoload_0, unk_autoload_2 or arm7.

args.name: maxCompiles
args.description: Cap how many orderings to compile.

tools.label: Pattern matcher
tools.description: Analyze the largest unmatched functions, find fuzzy assembly matches for an address, or scaffold drafts.

tools.label: Park a near-miss
tools.description: Park a logic-correct but not byte-exact draft with a NONMATCHING marker. It does not count as matched and must never be presented as one, but it is the best starting point for a later match.

tools.label: Ghidra draft
tools.description: Generate a Ghidra decompilation scaffold for a function. A structure hint to start from - never bank one as-is.

args.name: module
args.description: main, itcm, unk_autoload_0, unk_autoload_2 or arm7.

tools.label: m2c draft
tools.description: Generate an m2c decompilation scaffold. Same rule as the Ghidra one: a starting shape, not a match.

args.name: module
args.description: main, itcm, unk_autoload_0, unk_autoload_2 or arm7.

args.name: dumpAsm
args.description: Also print the generated GAS asm.

tools.label: Verify committed sources
tools.description: Recompile the sources a PR touches, resolving each symbol from the file's own decomp header, and byte-compare against the ROM with relocation slots wildcarded.

args.name: fail
args.description: Exit non-zero when anything fails to reproduce.

tools.label: Check the toolchain
tools.description: Confirm mwccarm and the python dependencies are present and usable.

tools.label: Extract the ROM
tools.description: Populate extracted/ from your own legally dumped DSi PictoChat title and ARM7 BIOS. Nothing ROM-derived is ever committed.
